_status: EXPLORATORY. Every finding here was generated from the existing corpus after the fact. None was predicted in advance. Label the section exploratory in the paper.

A_collapse_shape.reportable_claim: The collapse is gradual, not a step: logistic slopes in log K span 0.50 to 1.80 (n=11). The slope is strongly coupled to K50 (r=-0.84 in logs) and carries no information about scale once K50 is known (partial r=-0.17). Report the range; do NOT report a slope scaling law.

B_threshold_free_law.note: AUC is bounded in [0,1] and K50 is not, so the exponents are NOT comparable in magnitude to alpha=0.820. What replicates is the sign, the exclusion of zero, and the fit quality, with no threshold and no model dropped for censoring.

C_ceiling_uniformity.reportable_claim: 11 of 12 models hold a K=1 ceiling between 0.918 and 0.990; the exception is pythia-160m-x at 0.589. The ceiling is only weakly related to scale (R2=0.26), so K50 differences are not ceiling differences.

term2_midpoint_shift.note: The two normalisations disagree because interference lowers the K=1 ceiling itself (term 1). Own-ceiling normalisation divides out the very damage being measured. Report both.

term3_slope_change.VERDICT: NULL: interference does not systematically change the curve shape.

E_gpt2_sensitivity.reportable_claim: The continuous instrument places the GPT-2 family below the K=1 floor. Dropping all 3 GPT-2 models moves the old-recipe median from 3 to 4 and the median difference from 13 to 12, so the recipe split does not rest on them.

pythia_1b.abort_meaning: aborted = binding not decodable at that checkpoint (see analysis/qgeom_ladder_agg.py:47). Informative, not missing-at-random.

pythia_160m.abort_meaning: aborted = binding not decodable at that checkpoint (see analysis/qgeom_ladder_agg.py:47). Informative, not missing-at-random.

F_developmental_legibility.scope: One model with full controls (Pythia-1.4B, 7 checkpoints, leak-free layer selection, 7 distinct weight hashes, 0 aborts), one consistent second model with a hand-set layer (Pythia-1B), and one negative case (Pythia-160M, flat, 5 of 14 checkpoints not decodable).

released_models.note: The intervention re-injects the binding the PROBE decoded, not the gold label. It is the companion paper's result; reproduced here only to anchor the developmental trajectory below.

repairability_develops.VERDICT: Repairability is installed by pretraining and tracks legibility. At step 1000 the binding is not yet present (decode 0.144, read layer 1) and repair fails; by step 143000 repair reaches 0.686 with damage_keep 0.930.
